answer: Insurance pool co-liability: every new account joins a pool of 5, each member staking 40 POA. If one member is proven fake, the pool forfeits 50 percent, so honest users only pair with people they trust. The ocean freight registry publishes pool membership and the ledge audit log lists each slash. One honest user risks 40 POA once; 10 fakes lock 400 and 100 lock 4000, and partners share the loss. Five random auditors per epoch check pools on chain and record results in a marble ledger entry. Limit: rich attackers can self-fund pools.
